purpose: Test whether cluster-balanced Prediction Tracker forecasts contain incremental information beyond frozen Production V1, without granting production authority.

shared_contract.system_context_policy: PT plus Pathi/Big Al/Miner interactions remain in the separate PT external Miner; formal residual models exclude standalone system-state predictors so PT cannot receive false incremental credit.

challengers: BASE_CALIBRATION: no-PT Ridge residual recalibration control
PT_STANDALONE: cluster-balanced PT consensus fair value
PT_RESIDUAL: Ridge residual correction with PT plus base control
PT_CONDITIONAL_RESIDUAL: Ridge residual correction with PT agreement/disagreement and dispersion interactions
incremental_claim_rule: A PT challenger must beat frozen Production V1 and the best no-PT calibration control on untouched validation, pass MAE/RMSE and available Brier checks, show season stability, and have positive bootstrap MAE-gain confidence intervals. Otherwise PT remains backend research/shadow only.
